_about: Cue table for the Audio Studio runner (docs/spec/60-audio.md sections 2, 4, 5). Read by gen-music.mjs and master-audio.mjs. Prompts, seeds and loudness targets live here and nowhere else. beatsPerBar x bars x 60 / bpm is the loop length; duration/seconds is how long the studio is asked to generate (2-4 s longer so the master can be trimmed to whole bars).
musicExclusions: instrumental, no vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no electronic synth, no modern drum kit, no pop beat

cues.prompt: slow solemn ancient Chinese instrumental, guzheng arpeggios over a low frame drum pulse, erhu carrying a broad lyrical pentatonic theme, soft bronze bell on the downbeat, distant xiao flute, wide reverb like a great hall at night, noble and a little sad, D minor pentatonic

gentle spacious ancient Chinese instrumental for a quiet story scene, dizi flute and plucked pipa playing a simple pentatonic phrase, soft guzheng, light hand percussion, warm and reflective, slow harmonic movement, F major pentatonic

warm quiet ancient Chinese camp-at-night instrumental, soft bowed erhu, plucked guzheng, a slow wooden percussion pulse like a crackling fire, relaxed and homely, steady and unhurried, F major pentatonic

driving ancient Chinese war music for a tactical battle, deep taiko-style war drums playing a steady rolling pattern, plucked pipa and guzheng ostinato, low sustained horn-like drone, short suona calls every four bars, determined and rhythmic but with open space for a layer on top, steady energy not a climax, D minor pentatonic

tense ancient Chinese battle music, the melody stripped back, steady low war drums, tremolo strings holding a bare D minor drone, a single bronze bell on beat one of every other bar, rising unease, urgent but restrained, D minor pentatonic

cues.note: layer only; bar 1 is the 1-bar swell-in (60-audio section 3); the low register belongs to the drums
cues.prompt: full orchestral surge for a cavalry charge, layer only: fast driving spiccato string ostinato in the mid-high register, rising brass fanfare swells with horns and trumpets, a suona doubling the top line, deep taiko-style war drums carrying all the low end with steady eighth notes and accents on one and three, a snare roll swelling in the first bar, relentless and heroic, rising lines with no hummable melody, no bass, no cellos, no tuba, no sub-bass, no choir, D minor

cues.note: 6 bars = 14.4 s, then the natural ring-out is kept
cues.prompt: short triumphant ancient Chinese victory fanfare, suona and bright brass-like horns over rolling war drums and bronze bells, rising pentatonic line resolving to a held D major chord with a natural ring-out, proud and warm

cues.note: 4 bars = 14.5 s, then the natural fade-out is kept
cues.prompt: short sorrowful ancient Chinese defeat lament, a slow solo erhu phrase over a low drum heartbeat and a single bronze bell, falling pentatonic line settling on a held D minor note that fades into silence
a single deep war-drum strike with a short bronze gong shimmer, dry, punchy, one hit, tail under one second
cues.negative: music, melody, voices, speech, crowd, long reverb, long tail, hiss, noise

cues.prompt: a heavy wooden seal stamped onto a bamboo slip, one dull thud with a very short bright bell, dry, tail under half a second
cues.negative: music, melody, voices, speech, crowd, long reverb, long tail, hiss, noise
